title: Internal Research Opportunities and Funding (Tufts AS&E)
description:
The AS&E Scholarship & Research office's hub of internal undergraduate research opportunities and funding — Summer Scholars, the VERSE early-research program, the Undergraduate Research Fund, the Beckman and Laidlaw scholarships, and discipline-specific summer awards across Arts, Sciences, and Engineering.

title: Tufts Summer Scholars Program
description: A ten-week summer program in which undergraduates work closely with faculty from any of the Tufts campuses on an independent research project of their own design, supported by a summer stipend. Open to all disciplines; scholars present their work at a fall research symposium.
